steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility

steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Bootcamp. Attend synchronous sessions from anywhere, covering the PMBOK Guide framework and exam domains. steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After course completion, submit your formal PMP application directly to PMI, including proof of education and experience. Pay PMI's exam fee at application. Granite PM Academy provides guidance on documentation and the submission process to ensure accuracy.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice questions, study guides, and instructor office hours—to reinforce key concepts. Schedule your computer-based exam through PMI's testing partner. You will answer 180 questions over three hours in a proctored environment.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: Earn professional development units (PDUs) every three years to renew your PMP. Granite PM Academy offers continuing-education courses and resources to help you meet the PMI renewal cycle. Stay current with evolving project-management practices and industry standards.
